title: Pickup and Delivery Program Bonus on Northgate+ Business Cash
content:
Orders collected at a store earn the larger bonus. Under the Business earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the fulfilment program of the order adds percentage points to the Business earning percentage of the line the schedule settles. The program is the one the order is held in on its Northgate Store and Online Orders record.

| Fulfilment program of the order | Points added |
|---|---|
| Northgate Order Pickup | 0.5 |
| Northgate Drive Up | 0.5 |
| Northgate Ship to Home | 0.25 |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | 0.25 |
| Northgate In-Store Purchase or Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | none |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A school's order collected through Drive Up carries 0.5 added percentage points on its settled line; the same purchase delivered Same-Day carries 0.25.
